title: Eir: bond valence screening of crystal structures, with an integrity verdict
description:
Eir reads CIF files and asks two questions of each structure: can it be assessed at all, and if so, how well do its bond valence sums agree with the formal valences? It returns an integrity verdict (ACCEPT, FLAG, NOT_ASSESSED or EXPUNGE, with the code that decided it), the bond valence sum of every site, the global instability index, and the evidence for each. It runs as a Jupyter notebook or, from eir-bvs 2.1.0, as a Python package with a command line and a one-page report per structure.

This release is engine 2.0.46, packaged as eir-bvs 2.1.0. CHANGELOG.md describes every version.
